+import os
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MetricSeriesRequest:
+    metric_name: str
+    resource_a: str
+    resource_b: str
+    start_time: str
+    end_time: str
+    step_seconds: int = 60
+    dimensions: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: str) -> datetime:
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _bucket_timestamp(ts: datetime, step_seconds: int) -> int:
+    epoch = int(ts.timestamp())
+    return epoch - (epoch % step_seconds)
+
+
+def _fetch_openai_chat(prompt: str) -> str:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE}/chat/completions",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": "Extract structured metric comparison data from text."},
+                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+
+
+def compare_metric_series(
+    series_a: List[Tuple[str, float]],
+    series_b: List[Tuple[str, float]],
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    map_a = {k: v for k, v in series_a}
+    map_b = {k: v for k, v in series_b}
+    shared_keys = sorted(set(map_a) & set(map_b))
+    deltas = [{"timestamp": k, "delta": map_a[k] - map_b[k], "a": map_a[k], "b": map_b[k]} for k in shared_keys]
+    avg_a = sum(map_a.values()) / len(map_a) if map_a else 0.0
+    avg_b = sum(map_b.values()) / len(map_b) if map_b else 0.0
+    return {
+        "average_a": avg_a,
+        "average_b": avg_b,
+        "difference_in_average": avg_a - avg_b,
+        "shared_points": deltas,
+        "count_a": len(map_a),
+        "count_b": len(map_b),
+    }
+
+
+def _generate_sample_series(req: MetricSeriesRequest) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, float]], List[Tuple[str, float]]]:
+    start = _parse_iso8601(req.start_time)
+    end = _parse_iso8601(req.end_time)
+    cur = start
+    series_a: List[Tuple[str, float]] = []
+    series_b: List[Tuple[str, float]] = []
+    base = sum(ord(c) for c in (req.metric_name + req.resource_a + req.resource_b))
+    while cur <= end:
+        bucket = _bucket_timestamp(cur, req.step_seconds)
+        ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(bucket, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        value_a = ((base + bucket) % 100) / 3.0
+        value_b = ((base + bucket + 17) % 100) / 3.0
+        if req.dimensions:
+            value_a += len(req.dimensions)
+            value_b += len(req.dimensions) / 2.0
+        series_a.append((ts, value_a))
+        series_b.append((ts, value_b))
+        cur = cur.fromtimestamp(cur.timestamp() + req.step_seconds, tz=timezone.utc)
+    return series_a, series_b
+
+
+def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
+    if len(argv) < 5:
+        sys.stderr.write("usage: compare_metric_series.py <metric_name> <resource_a> <resource_b> <start_time> <end_time> [step_seconds]\n")
+        return 2
+    req = MetricSeriesRequest(
+        metric_name=argv[0],
+        resource_a=argv[1],
+        resource_b=argv[2],
+        start_time=argv[3],
+        end_time=argv[4],
+        step_seconds=int(argv[5]) if len(argv) > 5 else 60,
+    )
+    series_a, series_b = _generate_sample_series(req)
+    result = compare_metric_series(series_a, series_b)
+    analysis = _fetch_openai_chat(
+        f"Compare these two metric series for {req.metric_name}. Resource A: {series_a}. Resource B: {series_b}. Return a brief comparison."
+    )
+    output = {
+        "provider": "OpenAI API",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "comparison": result,
+        "analysis": analysis,
+    }
+    sys.stdout.write(str(output))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: filter_metric_dimensions.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import monitoring_v3
+
+
+def filter_metric_dimensions(
+    project_id: str,
+    metric_type: str,
+    resource_filters: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
+    metric_filters: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
+    time_interval_seconds: int = 3600,
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
+    project_name = f"projects/{project_id}"
+    interval = monitoring_v3.TimeInterval()
+    interval.end_time.seconds = int(__import__("time").time())
+    interval.start_time.seconds = interval.end_time.seconds - time_interval_seconds
+
+    filter_parts = [f'metric.type = "{metric_type}"']
+    for key, value in (resource_filters or {}).items():
+        filter_parts.append(f'resource.label."{key}" = "{value}"')
+    for key, value in (metric_filters or {}).items():
+        filter_parts.append(f'metric.label."{key}" = "{value}"')
+
+    request = monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest(
+        name=project_name,
+        filter=" AND ".join(filter_parts),
+        interval=interval,
+        view=monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
+    )
+
+    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for series in client.list_time_series(request=request):
+        points = []
+        for point in series.points:
+            points.append(
+                {
+                    "value": point.value.to_json(),
+                    "timestamp": point.interval.end_time.ToJsonString(),
+                }
+            )
+        results.append(
+            {
+                "metric_type": series.metric.type,
+                "resource_type": series.resource.type,
+                "metric_labels": dict(series.metric.labels),
+                "resource_labels": dict(series.resource.labels),
+                "points": points,
+            }
+        )
+    return results
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    metric_type = os.environ["METRIC_TYPE"]
+    resource_filters: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    metric_filters: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    results = filter_metric_dimensions(project_id, metric_type, resource_filters, metric_filters)
+    for item in results:
+        print(item)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
